{{Quote|No, Shmorg, I've got it.|The Gran offers to buy drinks, as opposed to Shmorg|<ref name="DFG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Gran''' operated as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Hired by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], he, along with numerous other [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] bounty hunters and [[Grave Tuskens]], was tasked with guarding the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. At some point during their occupation, the Gran, along with four others, headed to a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] for refreshments. A Gran named [[Shmorg]] offered to pick up the drink tab, but the Gran decided that he wanted to [[Currency/Legends|pay]] the bill instead. The posse argued over who was going to pay for the drinks, resulting in an unarmed brawl. All of the Gran were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] when he walked into the bar, which prompted the Gran to attack the fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, all of the Gran were killed by Katarn.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I wish you wouldn't shoot paying customers.|The bartender to Kyle Katarn, after the latter had killed the Gran and his partners|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] lived during the early reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="DF2" /> and operated as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="DFM">The ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' game manual identifies all [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] in the game as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]</ref> During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the Gran, along with numerous other Gran bounty hunters and [[Grave Tuskens]], were hired by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] to patrol the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. At some point, the Gran grouped with four other Gran,<ref name="DF2" /> one named [[Shmorg]],<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> and headed to a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="DF2" /> After ordering drinks from the [[Unidentified Barons Hed bartender|bartender]], Shmorg offered to [[Currency/Legends|pay]] the bill. The Gran countered Shmorg, and offered to pay instead. Shmorg did not take kindly to the Gran's generosity, however. An argument started, which soon engulfed the entire party. The heated exchanging of words quickly turned into an all out bare-knuckled brawl.<ref name="DFG" /> Although none of the Gran were armed, save for one Gran who had a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], the terrified [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] shouted for the violent [[Species/Legends|aliens]] to refrain from using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II}}
As soon as the brawl began, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainee [[Kyle Katarn]] entered the scene while [[Mission to Sulon|searching]] for a way into a large tower in the center of Barons Hed, known as the [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]]. The Gran turned their attention to Katarn and attacked him. The attack turned fruitless, as Katarn slew the Gran. The bartender verbally noted his displeasure at Katarn for killing paying customers as the Jedi made off with the one Gran's thermal detonators.<ref name="DF2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A brawler with big hands, the Gran was generous enough to offer to pick up a bar tab so that Shmorg wouldn't have to break out his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wallet]]. However, Shmorg did not accept the offer, and both Gran were quick to start an argument,<ref name="DFG" /> which turned into an ultimately fatal brawl.<ref name="DF2" />

He had brown [[Color/Legends|colored]] skin, purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In any case, if Gran are stupid enough to kill each other, be smart enough to let them.|Rick Barba on the bar brawl|<ref name="DFG" />}}
The unnamed Gran first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as an enemy character who appeared during the game's fifth level. In the guide, author [[Rick Barba]] theorized that the Gran were fighting over a bar tab, and advised the player to wait out their fight until at least two Gran were killed, and that after that the player should kill the remaining Gran and pillage the bar's supplies. It is never made clear which Gran is the one represented in this article.<ref name="DFG" /> However, due to the fact that completing this encounter is not necessary for beating the game for either of its two endings, this portion of the game can be skipped completely without effect.<ref name="DF2" />
